wg-tunnel.description: WG Tunnel is an alternative Android client for WireGuard and AmneziaWG, inspired by the official WireGuard Android app. It fills gaps in the official client by adding advanced features like auto-tunneling (on-demand VPN activation), while seamlessly supporting both protocols across app modes—including Kernel (for direct WireGuard kernel integration; AmneziaWG not supported), VPN (standard system-level tunneling), Lockdown (a custom kill switch for leak prevention), and Proxy (built-in HTTP/SOCKS5 forwarding)—for enhanced privacy, censorship resistance, and flexibility.
